title: Local LLM Engines
description: vLLM and Strata side by side, always split by engine and model: state, speed, latency, caches, GPUs, range history, and LiteLLM fallbacks as gateway context.

options.content:
Both local engines, side by side. **vLLM** and **Strata** export the same `vllm:` metric names, so every query here groups by `namespace` (the engine) and `model_name`; nothing sums across engines. Engine details: **vLLM Inference**, **Strata Inference**.

**Comparisons are history, not a benchmark:** each row is whatever that engine served in the range, with a different model, quantization, prompts and load. Strata's TTFT starts after its queue; vLLM's includes it. Controlled runs: `benchmarks/ai-realworld-load/`.

**The gateway is separate.** Apps call LiteLLM; when the local engine is full or fails, LiteLLM can send the request to a paid cloud model, which never reaches these engines. The last row counts only what LiteLLM itself reports; details on **AI Gateway and Analytics**.

panels.title: vLLM engine

targets.expr:
max(absent(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="vllm", deployment="vllm-server"})) * 4
  or (max(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="vllm", deployment="vllm-server"}) == 0) * 0 + 0
  or (max(up{namespace="vllm", job="vllm-service"}) == 0) * 0 + 1
  or (max(vllm:engine_sleep_state{namespace="vllm", sleep_state="awake"}) == 0) * 0 + 3
  or (max(up{namespace="vllm", job="vllm-service"}) == 1) * 0 + 2
  or vector(1)

panels.description: From Git replicas, the vLLM scrape target and its own state. Parked means 0 replicas on purpose (the other engine has the cards), not an outage.

panels.title: Strata engine

targets.expr:
max(absent(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="strata", deployment="strata-server"})) * 4
  or (max(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="strata", deployment="strata-server"}) == 0) * 0 + 0
  or (max(up{namespace="strata", job="strata-service"}) == 0) * 0 + 1
  or (max(strata:live_state{namespace="strata", state="unloaded"}) == 1) * 0 + 3
  or (max(up{namespace="strata", job="strata-service"}) == 1) * 0 + 2
  or vector(1)

panels.description: From Git replicas, the Strata scrape target and its own state. Parked means 0 replicas on purpose (the other engine has the cards), not an outage.

panels.title: Generated tokens/s now
panels.description: Wall clock, idle time counts as 0.

panels.title: History by engine and model (selected range)
Per-engine history

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:request_success_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range]))

sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:generation_tokens_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:request_success_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range]))

sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_count{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range]))

sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range]))

sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range]))

sum by (namespace) (label_replace(increase(DCGM_FI_DEV_TOTAL_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION{exported_namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range]), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.+)")) / 3600000 / on (namespace) group_right () (sum by (namespace, model_name) (increase(vllm:generation_tokens_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__range])) / 1000)

panels.description: One row per engine and model over the selected range. Different models, prompts and load: read it as history, not a benchmark. Per-stream decode = generated tokens ÷ decode time. GPU Wh counts the engine's cards for the whole range, idle included; if one engine served two models in the range both rows share that energy.

panels.title: Per-stream decode speed (1 ÷ mean inter-token latency)

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_count{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.description: What one stream sees while generating, token-weighted over the window. Same definition on both engines (decode time ÷ token gaps).

panels.title: Generated tokens/s (wall clock, idle included)
panels.description: Load, not speed: it drops whenever the engine waits for requests.

panels.title: Prefill speed

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{namespace="vllm", source="local_compute"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_sum{namespace="vllm"}[$__rate_interval]))

(sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace="strata"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace="strata"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(strata:totals_prompt_seconds_total{namespace="strata"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.description: Computed prompt tokens ÷ prefill time. vLLM uses its prefill histogram, Strata its own prompt-reading clock: close, not identical.

panels.title: Time to first token

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.description: vLLM includes queue wait; Strata starts after its queue.

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.title: Prompt (prefix) cache hit

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: vLLM: GPU KV prefix blocks. Strata: tokens kept from an earlier turn. Same idea, different cache.

panels.title: MTP draft acceptance

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, model_name) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{namespace=~"vllm|strata"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Only engines running speculative decoding appear; vLLM runs with MTP off.

panels.title: GPU power, both cards
panels.description: Sum of the cards each engine holds (cap 220 W each).

panels.title: LiteLLM fallbacks to another model (range)
panels.description: LiteLLM's successful fallbacks: the first model failed (status shown; 429 = its parallel limit) and another model answered. Those requests did not run on a local engine.

options.content: **Where the other traffic went:** spend and which backend answered are on **AI Gateway and Analytics** (`/d/ai-gateway-analytics`); per-request traces in Langfuse. GPU cards and the pods holding them: **GPU Overview** (`/d/gpu-overview`).
